tips.text: Land Ntofo Strikes twice in a row, then cast it a third time to stun and pull the enemy to you. Hit the first two on minions only if an enemy is in range.
Hold Path Maker a little longer before the dash lands, because a longer charge means a longer stun. You also take less damage while charging.
Use Footwork to dash onto the enemy, then fire the empowered Ntofo Strikes to fling them behind you, even through a wall.
Hit an enemy with an ability first, then follow with a basic attack. The mark adds extra damage to that attack.
Use All Out on an enemy standing near a wall. They get knocked through it and take a second hit.
Only go All Out when you can win the fight. You lose health and most of your bonus defenses while it lasts.
Path Maker no longer stuns or knocks back while you are All Out. Use it for extra damage and speed, and save the stun for before you go All Out.

combos.name: Wall slam ultimate
combos.when: When an enemy is standing with a thin wall behind them, such as in the lane or the jungle.
combos.text: Cast it on an enemy with a wall behind them. They are knocked through the wall and take a second hit, and then they are stunned and knocked up.

combos.name: Footwork into empowered Q
combos.when: When you have two Q stacks and the enemy is close to you.
combos.text: Dash onto or past the enemy, then cast the empowered Q. The pull flings them behind you, even through a wall.

combos.name: Charged W through the wave
combos.when: When you are about to go All Out and want to refresh W.
combos.text: Casting R refreshes W cooldown when you go All Out. Q and R can be cast during the W dash, so you can chain them for extra damage.

tips.text: Hit Aatrox with Ntofo Strikes twice to set up the stun and pull. Use it when he walks up to trade.
Use Path Maker as he winds up The Darkin Blade. You take less damage while charging, and the dash stuns him.
Dodge The Darkin Blade by moving sideways, away from the edge of each hit zone. The edge knocks you up.
Use Footwork to dodge his Infernal Chains or to close the gap, and take the shield with you.
Avoid long fights while Aatrox has his World Ender active. Kills extend it, so do not feed him.
Hit Akali with Ntofo Strikes twice to pull her in and stun her; that is your best chance to catch her.
Charge Path Maker longer when Akali is close, so it stuns for longer, and aim where she will stand.
Use Footwork's shield before Akali bursts you, and dash toward your allies to stay safe.
Think before using All Out near Akali. It lowers your health and resistances, so her burst can kill you.
Fight Akali when she is low on energy, because her Five Point Strike is much weaker then.
Aim Ntofo Strikes at Ambessa to land two hits, then use the stunning pull to trade.
Charge Path Maker longer when Ambessa stands still; the stun lasts longer the longer you charge.
Use Footwork to get your shield up before Ambessa trades.
Respect Ambessa's Repudiation shield; wait it out before you start hitting her.
Expect Ambessa to dash in with Public Execution at level 6. Stay healthy and keep your shield ready before she can reach you.
Walk up in a curve, not a straight line, so Flash Frost misses. Its stun at the end of its range hurts, so sidestep it.
Use Footwork to dash out of Flash Frost's path, and gain a shield while closing in on Anivia.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice to pull Anivia to you. Then stun her with the empowered one and trade before she can wall.
Path Maker can be recast through a wall's edge only if there is room; check where Crystallize sits before you charge.
Kill her once and expect Rebirth; stay and finish the egg, or leave it if the tower is near.
Do not stand in Glacial Storm for long; step out of it as it grows, because it slows you harder once fully formed.
Wait until Aurora uses The Weirding, then close in. She hops backward and it has a real cooldown.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice in a row to stun and pull her to you. Then follow up with Path Maker.
Use Footwork to shield against her Twofold Hex, and walk out of the way of its return hit.
Her Across the Veil makes her invisible only briefly. Don't chase her blindly; wait for her to come back.
All Out roots her and pulls her around, so she can't hop away with Across the Veil. Use it when she is close to terrain.
Hit Briar with Ntofo Strikes twice to set up the pull and stun. It stops her Blood Frenzy attack run on you.
Use Footwork to dodge away from Briar's leap. The shield also helps you survive her burst.
Charge Path Maker early when Briar is about to jump in. You take less damage while charging and the charge can't be interrupted.
Stay away from walls when Briar is charging Chilling Scream; a full charge there knocks you into the wall and stuns you.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice on Camille so the second one stuns and pulls her to you. Do it when she walks up to trade.
Use Path Maker when Camille dashes in with Hookshot. Charge it a bit longer for a longer stun.
Stay out of the outer edge of Tactical Sweep. It slows you and heals her.
Use Footwork to get away from The Hextech Ultimatum before she lands, since once the zone is up you can't leave it.
Think twice before going All Out in lane. You lose health and defense, and Camille can hit you hard.
Step sideways out of the smoke cloud when Rupture shows up; it takes a moment to land.
Stay out of Feral Scream's short range; being silenced stops your dashes and Path Maker.
Use Ntofo Strikes on minions to build stacks, then pull Cho'Gath in with the second one and stun him.
Shut down Cho'Gath's growth by trading before he eats champions or many minions, since Feast makes him much bigger.
Dash with Footwork to gain a shield before Cho'Gath trades with you.
Keep Ntofo Strikes landing on Darius to build two stacks. The second cast stuns him and pulls him in, so you pick the fight.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone. Footwork gives you a shield and a quick dash out of the pull.
Hold Path Maker until Darius is close. Charge it longer for a longer stun, then ram him back before he piles up Hemorrhage stacks.
Don't let Darius stack Hemorrhage on you. When he is at full stacks, back off, because Noxian Guillotine hits much harder.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw when you can. It slows you, heals Mundo when it hits you, and hurts more the more health you have.
Mundo resists the first stun on him. Hit him with Path Maker without expecting a stun, then use it again once the passive is spent.
Step on Mundo's dropped canister before he picks it up. It stops him healing and bringing his passive back sooner.
Hold back your damage while Heart Zapper is charging, because he heals back what he takes. Fight after it ends.
Be careful going All Out into Mundo. You lose a lot of health and defense, and Maximum Dosage lets him outlast you.
Don't cast Ntofo Strikes or Path Maker into Fiora while Riposte is ready; she can turn your stun back on you.
Bait Riposte with a cheap ability first, then use your stun or All Out once it is on cooldown.
Use Footwork's shield before she trades with Lunge, so her burst hits less.
Be careful going All Out near Fiora; you lose health and defenses, and her Grand Challenge can finish you.
Hit Ntofo Strikes twice, then use the shockwave to pull Gangplank in and stun him before he can place kegs.
Gangplank can cleanse your stun with Remove Scurvy. Bait it out before you commit with All Out.
Use Footwork's shield before you walk into Parrrley range; it soaks his poke.
Charge Path Maker longer when Gangplank can't dodge; it gives you damage reduction and a longer stun.
Stay out of kegs' blast zones; explosions slow and deal bonus damage to you. Attacking a keg yourself defuses it.
Watch for Cannon Barrage at level 6, especially when you are low on health; it can land from anywhere on the map.
Keep your distance from Garen and hit him with Ntofo Strikes; his Decisive Strike cleans the slow, so don't rely on it to hold him.
Land the second Ntofo Strikes to pull Garen in and stun him, then trade while he can't act.
Stay out of Garen's Judgment; use Footwork to dash away from its spin.
Back off when you're low; Demacian Justice deals more the less health you have.
Garen heals back quickly once he's left alone, so keep poking him to stop Perseverance.
Walk up and hit Gnar with Ntofo Strikes twice; the second cast pulls and stuns him. Do it when he is out of position.
Gnar outranges you, so use Footwork to shield and close in. Spare the shield for when you trade.
Charge Path Maker longer for a longer stun, and aim it at Gnar after he spends Hop.
When Gnar's Rage bar is nearly full, back off or stay out of his reach. Mega Gnar's Wallop stuns and his ultimate can knock you into walls.
Go to All Out when you can trap Gnar against a wall. You will take more damage in it, so be sure the kill is there.
Hit Gragas with Ntofo Strikes twice, then use the stunning pull when he walks up for Body Slam. It keeps him from starting the fight.
Charge Path Maker when Gragas is about to dash at you. It lets you take less damage and no knockback can move you.
Step out of the way of Barrel Roll when it is about to explode. Its slow gets stronger the longer it sits.
Be careful with All Out near Gragas, since you lose health and armor. His Explosive Cask can knock you away and leave you exposed.
Hit Ntofo Strikes twice to stun and pull Gwen, then follow up. She is easy to burst when she cannot escape.
Don't chase Gwen into Hallowed Mist; you cannot target her from outside it. Wait for it to end.
Hold Path Maker until Gwen uses Skip 'n Slash, then charge it for a longer stun when she is committed.
Don't let Gwen attack you freely; she needs several attacks to power up Snip Snip!. Slow her with Ntofo Strikes when she walks in.
Step out of the way between her Needlework casts; she needs to hit something to recast it.
Use Footwork for a shield before a trade; it absorbs some of her damage.
Hit Heimerdinger with Ntofo Strikes twice to pull and stun him, then hit him while he cannot place turrets.
Charge Path Maker out of sight of his grenade, then dash in; a long charge gives a longer stun on him.
Fight away from his turrets; they hurt, and he moves faster near them.
Use Footwork to dodge in and out of his range, and its shield soaks up his poke.
Take All Out only when you can finish him; you lose health and resistances while it lasts, and his rockets hurt more then.
Kill Illaoi's Tentacles when you can, because she is much weaker without them. Fight her away from terrain.
Hit Illaoi with Ntofo Strikes twice for the stun and pull. It drags her out of range of her Tentacles.
When Test of Spirit pulls your spirit out, hit Illaoi. Damaging her shortens the spirit's life.
Charge Path Maker before dashing into her. It reduces damage and cannot be interrupted, and a longer charge stuns longer.
Use Footwork to dodge her Tentacle Smash, since the cast is slow.
Hold Ntofo Strikes until it has two stacks; the shockwave pulls Irelia in and leaves her stunned.
Don't spend Path Maker when Irelia is charging Defiant Dance; she takes much less damage and can't be interrupted.
Fight her away from minions; Bladesurge needs them to chase you, so stay clear of low-health ones near you.
Use Footwork's shield before she dashes in, and watch for Flawless Duet, which stuns if both blades meet on you.
Hold All Out until Irelia's dashes are down; going All Out cuts your health, so she can burst you if she is ready.
Hit Jax with Ntofo Strikes twice for the stun and pull; it ruins his attack chain and Relentless Assault.
Wait out Counter Strike before you attack; it dodges your basic attacks and then stuns you.
Use Path Maker to stun Jax when his Leap Strike is down. Charge it longer for a longer stun.
Save All Out for a Jax who is low or near a wall, and expect a heavy trade because it lowers your health.
Close the gap with Footwork, then land Ntofo Strikes twice so the second stuns and pulls Jayce in.
Charge Path Maker longer before you release it; a longer charge reaches farther and stuns for longer.
Jayce's Shock Blast stops at the first unit it hits, so stand behind minions to block it.
Watch for Jayce's Acceleration Gate; it means a stronger Shock Blast is coming, so sidestep it.
Jayce is strong early and hits hard in his hammer form. Play safe if he gets ahead.
Use All Out with a wall behind Jayce to knock him over it and hit him twice.
Fight Kayle before level 6, while she is stuck in melee. Put her behind early.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice, then use the third to pull and stun her. She cannot kite you once she is stunned.
Charge Path Maker longer to stun her for longer. It cannot be interrupted, so use it when she tries to back away.
Do not use All Out when Kayle's Divine Judgment is ready. She can make herself invulnerable and wait you out while you are low on health.
Use Footwork to dodge Radiant Blast; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so shield up before trading.
Close the gap with Footwork, then land Ntofo Strikes twice to stun and pull Kennen onto you.
Use Footwork's shield when Kennen throws Thundering Shuriken; it blocks some of the poke.
Charge Path Maker longer before you dash at Kennen; a longer charge means a longer stun.
Count the Marks of the Storm on you. At the third mark you are stunned, so back off from Kennen's abilities.
Hit Kennen with All Out when he is out of position. He is fragile, and it can knock him through a wall.
Hit Ntofo Strikes twice, then use the third to pull and stun Kled. Follow up while he is stunned.
Use Footwork to dodge Bear Trap on a Rope. If it hooks you, move away from Kled before the rope pulls you in.
Wear down Skaarl first. Once Kled is dismounted he loses his abilities, so fight him then, and stay away when his courage is nearly full.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice in a row to pull and stun Malphite. Use it to start your trades.
Charge Path Maker longer before ramming Malphite; a longer charge stuns for longer. You take less damage while charging.
Use Footwork to dash out of Malphite's range and gain a shield. It also covers a trade.
Stay out of Malphite's reach at level 6 when All Out is down. His Unstoppable Force can't be stopped by your crowd control.
Stay out of reach when Mordekaiser has Darkness Rise running; its aura hurts anyone close to him.
Step out of the way of Death's Grasp. It pulls you in, so don't line up in a straight path to him.
Use Ntofo Strikes twice to land the stun and pull, then trade. Mordekaiser's shield grows from the damage you take.
Save Footwork to dash away once Mordekaiser casts Realm of Death, since you are alone in there.
Hit Ntofo Strikes twice, then use the third cast to stun and pull Naafiri in so you can trade on your terms.
Hold Path Maker until you see her commit. Charging it gives you damage reduction, and the dash stuns anyone it hits.
Use Footwork to dash onto her, then follow with a ready Ntofo Strikes. The shield also softens her burst.
Save All Out for when you can kill her. It makes you much squishier, and she has burst and Packmates to punish that.
Her Packmates add damage to every trade. Hit her with your abilities and auto attacks, not just the Packmates.
Hit Nasus with Ntofo Strikes twice to pull and stun him, then trade while he can't hit you back.
Harass Nasus when he goes for a last hit with Siphoning Strike. Stopping those kills keeps his damage low.
Stay out of Wither range or fight it early. It slows you more each second and cuts your Attack Speed.
Use Path Maker for a long stun on Nasus. A longer charge gives a longer stun, so charge it when he can't easily get away.
Use Footwork to dash away from Nasus, and the shield also cushions his Spirit Fire. Disengage when his Fury of the Sands is running.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice on Olaf, then the next one stuns and pulls him in so you can trade on your terms.
Don't waste Path Maker or All Out on Olaf during Ragnarok; he is immune to disables then.
Stay away from Undertow's axe path; if it hits you, you are slowed and lose Armor.
Keep Olaf from walking to his axe to cut down his poke in lane.
Finish Olaf before he gets low; Berserker Rage makes him hit harder and heal more the lower he is.
Stay away from walls when Ornn is near. Searing Charge into terrain knocks you up and stuns you.
Use Path Maker to stun Ornn. It makes you unstoppable while charging, so Bellows Breath will not stop it.
Land two Ntofo Strikes in a row, then the next one pulls Ornn in and stuns him. Use it when he is out of position.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture, because it slows you, and its pillar blocks your path.
Use Footwork to dash away from Ornn's stuns and get a shield while doing so.
Stay out of Comet Spear's line and don't stand low on health near Pantheon, because his thrown spear hits hard on weakened targets.
Hit Pantheon with two Ntofo Strikes in a row, then pull and stun him away from his wave.
Don't swing into Aegis Assault from the front; go around or wait it out, since he takes no damage from that side.
Charge Path Maker before he jumps; it makes you unstoppable, so Shield Vault can't stop you.
Walk up and use Ntofo Strikes twice on Quinn. The second cast stuns and pulls her to you, so she cannot kite away.
Charge Path Maker longer when Quinn is cornered. It gives you damage reduction while you charge, and the stun lasts longer.
Use Footwork to shield yourself as you step in on her. It makes her trades cost her more.
Quinn is weaker up close. Her Vault knocks you back a little and slows you, so ignore it and chase her.
When Quinn's Blinding Assault is up, expect your vision to shrink if she hits you. Stay beside minions, since the first enemy it hits stops it.
Look for All Out when she Vaults away near a wall. Pushing her through terrain adds a second hit and a stun.
Hitting Quinn while she uses Behind Enemy Lines removes her speed bonus for a while, so punish her when she tries to roam.
Charge Path Maker longer when you can, since a longer charge stuns longer and goes farther. Aim it at Renekton when he is out of Fury.
Watch his Fury. When it is high, his Ruthless Predator stuns for much longer, so keep your distance.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice to pull and stun Renekton. Then follow up while he can't act.
Use Footwork's shield when Renekton dashes in. It softens his trade.
Poke him while he has little Fury, since fighting is how he gets strong.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice on Riven for the pull and stun. Hit her while she dashes in, since the first hit slows her.
Keep Footwork for after she uses Ki Burst or Broken Wings. The shield soaks her burst and you can dash out.
Charge Path Maker longer for a longer stun. Cast it when she has used her dashes, since she cannot easily escape.
Be careful with All Out when Riven has her burst ready, because you lose a lot of health and resistances.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice, then the next one pulls Rumble in and stuns him. Use that to start your fight.
Charge Path Maker longer when Rumble is close; a longer charge gives a longer stun and more reach.
Step out of The Equalizer fire quickly instead of fighting inside it, and use Footwork to leave.
Go in when Rumble is Overheating; he cannot cast spells then, so trade freely.
Rumble deals magic damage, which your bonus Magic Resist helps against. Do not go All Out early, because it removes that bonus.
Keep Ntofo Strikes ready to land two hits on Sett; the stun and pull stops him from running you down.
Don't stand between Sett and a minion; Facebreaker on both sides stuns you.
Back off after a trade; Sett's Haymaker is strongest when he has soaked up damage from you.
Step out of the middle of Haymaker; only the center deals true damage.
Use Footwork to dodge Sett's burst and take a shield while you move.
Hold All Out for when Sett lacks his grab. He can pull you in with The Show Stopper, and All Out lowers your health and armor.
Charge Path Maker fully before ramming Sett; it stuns longer. You take less damage while charging.
Don't walk into Shadow Dash range for a casual trade; being taunted lets Shen hit you with his empowered attacks.
Hit Shen with two Ntofo Strikes in a row so the third stuns and pulls him in for a trade.
Wait out Spirit's Refuge before you attack; your basic attacks are blocked inside it.
Use Path Maker's charge to become Unstoppable, so Shen's taunt won't stop it.
Watch for Shen vanishing at level 6; his Stand United can bring him to a fight in another lane, so play safe if he's missing.
Dodge the Mega Adhesive field; if Singed Flings you into it, you are rooted.
Land two Ntofo Strikes hits, then fire the shockwave to pull Singed in and stun him.
Don't chase Singed through his Poison Trail; he wants you to follow him.
Use Footwork for its shield when you trade into Singed's trail, then step out.
Charge Path Maker longer to stun Singed for longer, but keep clear of Fling range.
Hit Sion with Ntofo Strikes twice. The second cast pulls and stuns him, which interrupts his Decimating Smash charge.
Use Path Maker as Sion starts charging his axe. You are Unstoppable while you charge, and you can knock him back and stun him.
Sidestep Roar of the Slayer. It is a thin line, and Sion usually follows it with a big Decimating Smash.
Dash away with Footwork when Sion charges Unstoppable Onslaught. Stay out of its path, since a late dodge means a stun.
Back off after you kill Sion. His Glory in Death makes him hit very fast for a short time, so do not stand and fight.
Hit Tahm Kench with Ntofo Strikes twice to stun and pull him. This works well when he walks up to attack minions.
Stay out of his Tongue Lash line, and keep minions between you when he has stacks. Three stacks means a stun, and then Devour.
Charge Path Maker when you see Abyssal Dive start. It can't be interrupted, and it lowers the damage you take while you wait.
Hit him hard in short trades. Thick Skin stores damage and heals only when he goes unhit for a few seconds, so keep pressing.
Close the gap with Footwork, then use Ntofo Strikes twice to pull Teemo in and stun him.
Charge Path Maker longer when Teemo is stuck on you; the stun lasts longer the longer you charge.
Walk around mushrooms and brush before fighting. Noxious Trap slows you and reveals you.
Don't fight in a brush where Teemo may be hiding with Guerrilla Warfare. Wait for him to attack and give himself away.
Don't linger after Blinding Dart. Back out before Toxic Shot's poison adds up.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice, then fire the shockwave to stun and pull Tryndamere into your fight.
Hold Path Maker for Tryndamere's dash in; its charge cannot be interrupted and it cuts damage while you charge.
Keep Tryndamere from last-hitting by poking him early, so he builds little Fury to heal with Bloodlust.
Do not spend All Out while Undying Rage is ready; he refuses to die and your lower health makes you easy to hurt.
Use Footwork to dodge away from Spinning Slash and keep the shield up when Tryndamere trades.
Stay out of Corrosive Charge range, and do not stand still on a minion wave where it lands; it slows you.
Hit Urgot with two Ntofo Strikes in a row, then pull him in with the empowered one to trap him close.
Sidestep Disdain's dash. It stops at the first champion it hits and stuns, so do not walk straight at Urgot.
Use Path Maker through Purge's fire; K'Sante has damage reduction and cannot be interrupted while charging.
Do not fall low near Urgot; Fear Beyond Death can drag you in and execute you under a quarter health.
Hit Varus with Ntofo Strikes twice to pull and stun him, then walk onto him. He is weak up close.
Use Footwork to dodge a charged Piercing Arrow, and for a shield while you close the gap.
Charge Path Maker out of his sight and release it when he is close. Longer charge means a longer stun, and you take less damage while charging.
Hail of Arrows slows you in the area; step out of it instead of fighting inside it.
Respect Chain of Corruption at level 6. Going All Out lowers your health, so don't use it while Varus has his root ready.
Hit Ntofo Strikes twice on Vayne to pull and stun her. She is fragile and dies fast once caught.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready. A wall hit stuns you and deals heavy damage.
Charge Path Maker to be immune to displacement. That counters Condemn, and the wall stun can't happen.
Use Footwork to close the gap on Vayne, then follow with Path Maker or Ntofo Strikes before she tumbles away.
Trade early and often, because Vayne gets scary with Silver Bolts once she has more items. Do not let her hit three times in a row.
Hit Vladimir with Ntofo Strikes twice to pull and stun him, then follow with your attacks. Keep him close.
Charge Path Maker long when Vladimir has just used Sanguine Pool. Wait for it to end, because you can't hit him while he is in the pool.
Don't stand in Vladimir's pool; it slows you and drains health. Walk out of it rather than fight inside it.
Use Footwork to dash away from Hemoplague's area, since its damage and healing land after it ends.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice in a row to get the shockwave. It pulls Volibear in and stuns him, so use it to start a trade on your terms.
Use Path Maker the moment Volibear starts to dive. You take less damage while charging and cannot be interrupted.
Step out of the Sky Splitter area when you see him cast. If you get hit, you are slowed.
Use Footwork for its shield when he commits to a trade, and keep your distance until his Thundering Smash runs out.
Hit Ntofo Strikes twice, then fire the shockwave to pull and stun Xin Zhao when he charges in.
Use Path Maker as Xin Zhao commits with Three Talon Strike. You cannot be interrupted, and you take less damage while charging.
Use Footwork to dash away from Audacious Charge and gain a shield. Do not waste it early.
Stay away when Xin Zhao has Wind Becomes Lightning ready. Being hit slows you and marks you, so he can charge from farther away.
Hit Yasuo with Ntofo Strikes twice, then the shockwave pulls and stuns him. Aim it carefully, because Wind Wall will destroy it.
Bait Wind Wall with a plain Ntofo Strikes first, then throw the shockwave once the wall is on cooldown.
Use Path Maker through Yasuo's Wind Wall; it is a dash, not a projectile, so the wall does not stop it. Charge longer for a longer stun.
Be careful of the whirlwind from Steel Tempest after two hits; it knocks you up. Step out of line when he has two stacks.
Yasuo's Last Breath needs you airborne. Stay away from allies who can knock you up, and keep Yasuo off you when they can.
Cast All Out when Yasuo stands near a wall; it carries him through the terrain and you strike twice.
Hit Yone with Ntofo Strikes twice in a row. The second cast pulls him in and stuns him, so follow up right away.
Charge Path Maker longer for a longer stun. Cast it when Yone is committed to a trade.
Use Footwork to dodge Yone's stacked Mortal Steel and get a shield for the trade.
Don't chase Yone when he uses Soul Unbound; he will snap back to his body and repeat the damage he dealt.
Don't charge Path Maker into a Dark Procession wall; it blocks your dash. Wait for it to fade or hit it down.
Kill Mist Walkers quickly with a basic attack; they die easily. Then fight Yorick alone.
Land two Ntofo Strikes in a row to pull Yorick in and stun him, then follow up with your attacks.
Sidestep Mourning Mist; it slows you and marks you so Mist Walkers leap onto you.
Use Footwork to dodge Mourning Mist, and for a shield while you trade.
Use Footwork to dash away from Dreaded Return and gain a shield; leaving the line stops the stun and pull.
Land Ntofo Strikes twice, then fire the shockwave to pull Zaahen in and stun him before Cultivation of War builds up.
Trade with Ntofo Strikes and Path Maker while Zaahen has few stacks from Cultivation of War, and back off once he is full, because he hits much harder.
Do not rely on killing a full-stack Zaahen in one go. He can revive from lethal damage, so hold All Out until the revive is gone.
Charge Path Maker when Zaahen commits to Grim Deliverance; it cuts damage you take while charging, and you can dash back out.
